q1_issues.issue: "the Ministry" is capitalized and denotes an organization, so the proper-noun rule calls for a name-derived symbol plus a (Name ...) atom rather than the anonymous witness sk_ministry_1.

notes: The framing PP "at the executive level" correctly takes the preposition-named oblique At on the event, "the central arm of the Ministry" correctly takes PartOf, and the present-tense stative correctly gets no tense atom. The central_arm / executive_level fusions with an exposed positional-adjectival modifier genus are borderline but stay inside the compound-kind rules.
